checks: Original ZIP is opened read-only and never deleted; splitter requires caller expected complete SHA and verifies size/stat stability and full streamed bytes before successful manifest.
Fresh parts subdirectory resolves below the fixed delivery_parts root; exclusive xb writes and existing-directory refusal preserve prior files.
Each generated data part is at most 64MiB and all ordered parts are listed by exact bytes/hash.

Reassembler requires caller trusted manifest SHA plus exact pinned companion bytes. Part names are fixed archive.partNNNN with strict integer indices/count/sizes and resolved paths remain directly under manifest parent.
Reassembled output is explicitly caller supplied, not derived from untrusted archive.name; existing destination rejected and xb prevents overwrite. Its parent must already exist.
Each part is checked before output creation and again during copying; saved complete ZIP length/SHA is read back. Failed new partial outputs are retained and not declared verified.
limits: Source-only review; no ZIP or parts read, no split/reassembly execution, no extraction, no scientific audit.
Output may intentionally be in any caller-explicit existing directory; only part resolution is confined to manifest directory.
A concurrently changed input may leave an incomplete fresh output before hash rejection; no claim of atomic artifact creation or adversarial filesystem-race resistance.
